$comment: QA's expected compatibility rule set: the 20 rule ids of docs/qa/test-plan.md §9.2 (v4), which are the 18 ids of test plan v3 plus cooler-socket and display-output (Hazem, 2026-10-02, phase-1-plan §6), agreed with build-lead (src/engine/types.ts RULE_IDS at 4fa8a95). unknownData re-checked against WP-D1 batch 1 (feat/data-engine-data @ c588afb) and against build-lead's RuleSpec at 480a30e (cooler-height reads the memory kit), as the Director's ruling asks for every field a rule starts to read. syntheticNull marks the four rules of the Director's ruling of 2026-10-03 (gpu-length, cooler-height, psu-form-factor, psu-length). tests/audit/compat-trace.mjs checks the engine's registry against this list and every rule's tests against its fields. Owner: qa-lead. A change here needs the same change in test plan §9.2 (tests/audit/compat-trace.test.mjs pins both) and the Director's approval, recorded in test plan §16.

fields.outcomes: Every status the rule returns for real, fully published data. Each needs at least one passing test of that kind: 'ok' is the positive test, and 'warn' and 'block' are the negative tests.
fields.numeric: The rule compares a number with a limit, so it needs 'boundary at', 'boundary inside' and 'boundary outside' tests (test plan §9.1).
fields.unknownData: true: the rule's decision can depend on a value the data does not publish, so it needs an 'unknown' test, and an unpublished value gives warn with cantVerify, never ok (budget.json compatibility.unknownDataMustNotReturn). false: every value the rule reads is required, so valid data cannot be unpublished there (the Director's ruling, 2026-10-02, phase-1-plan WP-E1).
fields.unpublishable: For unknownData true: the values that can be unpublished, as dot paths (category.field, [] for every list item).
fields.requiredFields: For unknownData false: each field the rule reads, and the proof that it cannot be unpublished. 'null-rejected' and 'empty-rejected' name a validator test that must pass in a file under src/data/; 'validator' names an existing validator test; 'none-by-definition' is a field whose schema defines null or [] as 'the part has none', a real answer, so no test applies. Re-checked whenever a rule starts to read a new field.
fields.variants: Cases a decision requires to be told apart. Each needs at least one passing test of that kind whose description matches the pattern (case-insensitive).
fields.syntheticNull: true for the only rules whose unknown-data test may set a published field to null on a real catalogue record, titled '[<rule-id>] unknown: <description> (synthetic null on <part id>)', because no catalogue product has the null (the Director's ruling, 2026-10-03, test plan §9.1). compat-trace fails a synthetic null on any other rule, in any other kind of test, in any other wording, or on a part id that is not in the catalogue.
fields.syntheticNullWhy: For syntheticNull true: why no real product can give the rule's unknown-data test.
fields.data: When the rule's test data exists (phase-1-plan §3): ready, or the work package it waits for.

rules.check: The CPU socket matches the board
The board's CPU support list includes the CPU

requiredFields.test: bios-coverage: every catalogue CPU on the socket has a BIOS row

rules.check: Whether the CPU needs a newer BIOS than the board shipped with, and whether the board has BIOS FlashBack
unpublishable: motherboard: the first-BIOS or launch date that WP-D1 item 5 adds, when the maker does not publish it

variants.why: phase-1-plan WP-E1: where the board has BIOS FlashBack, the warning gives the update steps
Hazem, 2026-10-02 (phase-1-plan §6.1): warn, not block; the warning names the BIOS version needed and tells the buyer to ask the retailer for a board already updated to it

rules.data: ready; the BIOS dates need WP-D1

rules.check: The kit's memory type (DDR4 or DDR5) matches the board
The kit's modules fit the board's DIMM slots
The kit's speed against the board's and the CPU's official speeds
unpublishable: ram: the modules' rank, which the schema does not hold; the CPU's official speed depends on it for DDR4 with 4 modules (Ryzen 5000: 4x1R 2933 MT/s, 4x2R 2667 MT/s, data/parts/cpu.json)

rules.check: The card's length against the case, per layout
unpublishable: case.gpuClearance[].condition: a radiator of a size that the case's conditional rows do not list, at their position, has no published limit (WP-D1 batch 1, c588afb)
rules.syntheticNullWhy: No catalogue product has this null today, so the unknown-data test sets the field to null on a real record (the Director's ruling, 2026-10-03, from the WP-D1 batch 1 review). Take the mark off when a real product with the null joins the catalogue.

rules.check: The card's thickness against the board's slot spacing and the case's expansion slots
rules.data: the Terra's data is ready; the board slots need WP-D1

rules.check: The air cooler's height against the case, per layout
unpublishable: ram.heightMm: a kit taller than the cooler's memory clearance raises the front fan, and the cooler's height with it (build-lead's RuleSpec, 480a30e)
rules.syntheticNullWhy: No catalogue product has this null today, so the unknown-data test sets the field to null on a real record (the Director's ruling, 2026-10-03, from the WP-D1 batch 1 review). Take the mark off when a real product with the null joins the catalogue.

rules.check: The RAM's height under the air cooler's overhang
The radiator's size and position against the case
The PSU's form factor against the case
unpublishable: psu.atxBracketIncluded: on an SFX or SFX-L unit, when the maker does not say (WP-D1 batch 1, c588afb)
rules.syntheticNullWhy: No catalogue product has this null today, so the unknown-data test sets the field to null on a real record (the Director's ruling, 2026-10-03, from the WP-D1 batch 1 review). Take the mark off when a real product with the null joins the catalogue.

rules.check: The PSU's length against the case, per layout
rules.syntheticNullWhy: No catalogue product has this null today, so the unknown-data test sets the field to null on a real record (the Director's ruling, 2026-10-03, from the WP-D1 batch 1 review). Take the mark off when a real product with the null joins the catalogue.

rules.check: The PSU's wattage against the estimated load, with transient headroom
A native 12V-2x6 where the card needs one, and enough 8-pin cables
unpublishable: gpu-card: the 16-pin connector's standard (12V-2x6 or 12VHPWR), when the maker does not name it
gpu-card.powerAdapter, on a 16-pin card (WP-D1 batch 1, c588afb)

rules.check: The M.2 drive count against the board's slots, and lane-sharing side effects

requiredFields.why: [] means the board has no M.2 slot

requiredFields.test: [schema] motherboard.m2Slots[].sizes: an empty list is rejected

requiredFields.why: [] means the board has no SATA port

[] means the maker publishes no lane sharing for the board: the manual has no sharing statement, while the boards that share lanes state it in their specification footnotes (data-lead searched each manual in full, 2026-10-03). The m2-lanes worker re-checks every [] against the manual and the spec page

rules.check: The board's form factor against the case

requiredFields.test: [schema] case.supportedBoards: an empty list is rejected

rules.check: A front USB-C port needs a USB-C header on the board

requiredFields.why: [] means the case has no front USB-C port
[] means the board has no front USB-C header

rules.check: The cooler's mounting kit fits the CPU socket, or the board's while no CPU is picked

requiredFields.test: [schema] cooler.sockets: an empty list is rejected

requiredFields.why: the board's socket stands in while no CPU is picked (build-lead's follow-up 5, 480a30e)

rules.check: A build with no graphics card needs a CPU with integrated graphics

requiredFields.why: src/data/schema/cpu.ts: null means no integrated graphics (Intel F SKUs), a real answer
